subject: Demo on hold — prospect shifts to launch readiness
messages:
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwoodinference.com>
To: Ethan Cole <ethan.cole@lumenbio.com>, Priya Rao <prao@lumenbio.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 3 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Demo: Redwood inference walkthrough — Wed Aug 11 10:00am PT

Hi Ethan / Priya —

Quick follow-up to lock in the Redwood demo we discussed. We have Wed Aug 11 at 10:00am PT available for a ~45 minute walkthrough + Q&A. Proposed agenda attached: demo_agenda.pdf (short), MAP_demo_deck_v2.pdf.

Agenda (high level)
- 5m intros and goals
- 20m runtime + deployment modes (hosted, dedicated, private) + performance benchmarks
- 10m integration checklist (auth, VPC, data handling)
- 10m next steps / procurement / timelines

If that time works I’ll send a calendar invite. If not, propose two other slots: Thu Aug 12 9:00am PT or Tue Aug 17 11:00am PT.

Thanks — excited to show you how we can keep inference predictable while cutting unit costs.

Best regards,
Stephanie Nguyen
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
stephanie_nguyen@redwoodinference.com
(415) 555-0123

Attachments: MAP_demo_deck_v2.pdf, demo_agenda.pdf
From: Ethan Cole <ethan.cole@lumenbio.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Priya Rao <prao@lumenbio.com>
Date: Wed, 5 Aug 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Demo: Redwood inference walkthrough — Wed Aug 11 10:00am PT

Hi Stephanie —

Thanks for the note and for building the agenda. I’m sorry to say we need to pause the demo for now. We just went through a short leadership sync and are pulling resources into a launch-readiness sprint for Q3 — this is primarily an org prioritization decision (engineering headcount + travel for the product team). Given that, the LLM/inference proof-of-concept is being deprioritized until we stabilize the launch.

Can we park the demo and revisit in early Q1 next year? If it helps, send a 1‑page summary of the value props and any lightweight integration pre-reqs we can pass to the platform team.

Appreciate your flexibility — we don’t want to close the door entirely, just need to clear the calendar while we reallocate engineers.

Best,
Ethan
Head of ML | LumenBio
ethan.cole@lumenbio.com

From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 6 Aug 2026 09:22:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Re: Demo: Redwood inference walkthrough — Aug 11 (prospect deprioritized)

Marissa / Jonas — forwarding Ethan’s note. Short recap and my proposed plan below.

Recap: LumenBio has pulled engineering focus into a launch readiness sprint and asked to park the inference pilot. They asked for a 1‑page summary in the meantime and to re-evaluate in Q1. Travel + headcount squeeze cited.

Options I recommend (in order):
1) Send a concise 1‑page value summary + integration checklist this week (no demo). Keep them in nurture and checkbox a Q1 follow-up.
2) Offer a time-limited evaluation environment (30 days free infra credits) rather than a discount — low risk, preserves pricing integrity.
3) Place a tentative placeholder calendar invite for early Feb 2027 and mark as tentative in HubSpot.

Questions for you: are we ok offering 30 days of infra credits for a POC on this account? If not, I can ask for approval to offer a short technical review instead (no credits) and keep the deal in nurture.

Jonas — any guidance on cadence? I’ll draft the 1‑pager and a short HubSpot update if you’re ok with the nurture approach.

Thanks,
Stephanie

---
Jonas Weber replied:

> Let’s avoid a straight discount for now. Offer the eval environment + 2 short check-ins (30/60 days). Keep the calendar placeholder for Feb and add to our renewal cadence. If they push again, route to Marissa for expansion later.
> 
> Jonas
> Director, Sales | Redwood Inference
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwoodinference.com>
To: Ethan Cole <ethan.cole@lumenbio.com>, Priya Rao <prao@lumenbio.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 11 Aug 2026 15:05:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Demo on hold — Redwood nurture plan

Hi Ethan / Priya —

Totally understand — thank you for the heads up. We’ll park the Aug demo and keep things light until you’re ready. Per your ask, attached is a 1‑page summary and the integration checklist (MAP_demo_deck_v2.pdf — see first two slides for quick highlights). I’ll also put a tentative placeholder invite for the week of Feb 7, 2027 and mark it tentative so it won’t clutter calendars.

What we can offer now (no immediate commitment):
- 30 day eval environment (infra credits) + 2 short technical check-ins at 30/60 days (Jonas approved).
- A short integrations checklist you can hand the platform team (attached).
- I’ll update HubSpot (HB-4982) to reflect pause and add a Q1 follow-up task.

If you prefer we just leave it paused with no calendar placeholder, tell me and I’ll only add it to our internal nurture queue. Otherwise I’ll send the one‑pager and tentative invite today.

Thanks again — we’ll be here when the timing is right.

Best,
Stephanie Nguyen
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
stephanie_nguyen@redwoodinference.com
(415) 555-0123
